name: Kenny Baker
biography: Kenneth George "Kenny" Baker (August 24, 1934 – August 13, 2016) was a British actor and musician, best known as the man inside R2-D2 in the popular Star Wars film series.
movies: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
